objective: Independently replicate the frozen v75 layer-59 mixed-cell payload on newly authored, disjoint, non-benchmark prompts without changing a code, scale, selected cell, payload byte, rate, or gate after observing the new activations.

fresh_prompt_protocol.provenance: Newly authored synthetic engineering and explanatory prompts, frozen in this preregistration before tokenization, propagation, or measurement.
prompts: A storage service receives duplicate completion callbacks after a network retry. Explain an idempotent state transition design and identify the invariant that prevents double accounting.
Explain why the eigenvalues of a triangular matrix are visible on its diagonal, then give an intuitive geometric interpretation without relying on a numerical example.
Design a bounded concurrent logging buffer for a CPU inference server. Discuss ownership, backpressure, ordering, and what should happen when a writer crashes midway.
A compiler lowers a high-level matrix expression into vector instructions. Trace the transformations that preserve semantics and name two mistakes that could silently change rounding behavior.
Compare arithmetic coding with fixed-width symbol packing for a small neural-network weight alphabet, focusing on random access, branch cost, metadata, and decode throughput.
Write a concise incident analysis for a cache invalidation bug that only appears after a rolling deployment, including the causal chain and a durable prevention mechanism.
Describe how to test whether a faster approximation kernel is genuinely correct when errors may cancel in aggregate but concentrate in a few output channels.
An online scheduler must share four physical CPU cores between prompt processing and token generation. Propose a policy and explain how you would measure tail-latency regressions.
fresh_prompt_protocol.row_selection: Flatten valid non-padding token positions in prompt order and deterministically choose 64 evenly spaced unique positions.

decision.if_pass: Treat the fixed-cell scale algebra as independently replicated at layer 59 and preregister the same representation family on representative early, middle, and late Qwen3.8-27B layers.
decision.if_fail: Reject v75 as a non-replicating development result; do not tune the artifact or rate on these fresh prompts.

claim_boundary: Fresh-prompt layer-59 replication of one frozen complete-MLP approximation only. A pass establishes out-of-development-prompt replication of the local algebra, but not whole-model capability, benchmark retention, CPU throughput, energy, novelty, 100 tokens per second, or a scientific breakthrough.
